# `window_time`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Extract the time value from time/session window column which can be used for event time value of window.
The extracted time is (window.end - 1) which reflects the fact that the aggregating
windows have exclusive upper bound - [start, end)
See <a href="https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/structured-streaming-programming-guide.html#window-operations-on-event-time">'Window Operations on Event Time'</a> in Structured Streaming guide doc for detailed explanation and examples.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
window_time(window_column)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- window_time, example 1
> SELECT a, window.start as start, window.end as end, window_time(window), cnt FROM (SELECT a, window, count(*) as cnt FROM VALUES ('A1', '2021-01-01 00:00:00'), ('A1', '2021-01-01 00:04:30'), ('A1', '2021-01-01 00:06:00'), ('A2', '2021-01-01 00:01:00') AS tab(a, b) GROUP by a, window(b, '5 minutes') ORDER BY a, window.start);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
